resources.string: Discover a hidden image or assemble your photos, with a grid adapted to their format.
Hidden surprise image. No image preview.
The puzzle in progress will be replaced.
Return loose pieces to the carousel
Unlock transparent image guide for %1$d neutrino for this entire puzzle
Unlock a transparent guide for this entire puzzle. Show or hide it freely afterwards. Your completion reward stays the same.
The purchase could not be saved. Please try again.

Jigsaw table. Use one finger to move pieces, browse the carousel or drag the background to move the table. Use two fingers together to move or zoom the table. The corner marks indicate the puzzle frame.
Free jigsaw table. Use one finger to move a piece or group, or drag the background to move the table. Use two fingers together to move or zoom the table. The corner marks indicate the puzzle frame.
Completed puzzle. The full image is revealed. Drag with one finger to move the image. Use two fingers together to zoom or move it.

Choose a surprise image or a photo from your device, then the number of pieces, the arrangement and, if you like, piece rotation. No preview: the image appears through its pieces, then in full at the end.

Carousel: browse the bottom tray and drag a piece upwards to put it on the table. To put a loose piece back, drop it on the carousel or tap it twice.

Free table: the pieces start scattered around the empty frame.

One finger moves a piece or a group; on the background, it moves the table. Two fingers move and zoom the table. The coloured corner marks show the frame. Line a piece up with its neighbour or with its place in the frame, then release it to attach it.

The eye unlocks the transparent image for the whole puzzle; its price is on its badge. Afterwards, it shows or hides the image for free. Your reward stays the same.

With rotation on, touch a piece, then the rotate button. The ⋮ menu shows only the edge pieces and tidies loose pieces. The four-corner button recentres the table.

The neutrino reward depends on the number of pieces and is paid once per puzzle. Progress saves by itself; one puzzle is kept at a time.
